answer: Each new identity must lock a non-transferable onyx bond and staff one jetty through a full horizon of verified deliveries before it can vote or earn. Leaving early forfeits the bond, and finishing releases it only for that identity. Waiting cannot be pooled: ten clones must each staff a jetty for the whole horizon and lock ten bonds, so a farm pays ten bonds plus ten separate waiting periods for ten votes, while one honest agent pays one bond and one horizon.
